description: This file defines an interface, ExtensionInterface, that must be implemented by extension classes in the Twig templating engine. It specifies methods for adding token parsers, node visitors, filters, tests, functions, and operators to Twig.

classes.name: ExtensionInterface
classes.description: Defines the required methods for Twig extension classes to integrate custom functionalities like token parsers, node visitors, filters, tests, functions, and operators into Twig templates.

methods.name: getTokenParsers
methods.description: Returns a list of token parser instances to be added to Twig.

methods.name: getNodeVisitors
methods.description: Returns a list of node visitor instances for Twig.

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Returns a list of TwigFilter objects representing filters to add to Twig.

methods.name: getTests
methods.description: Returns a list of TwigTest objects representing tests to add to Twig.

methods.name: getFunctions
methods.description: Returns a list of TwigFunction objects representing functions to add to Twig.

methods.name: getOperators
methods.description: Returns a nested array defining unary and binary operators, their precedences, and associated classes.
